name: NH48
label: Delhi – Jaipur – Ahmedabad – Mumbai
note: Dense dhaba clusters and NHAI wayside amenities; fuel-court food courts roughly every 60-80 km.

name: NH44
label: Srinagar – Delhi – Hyderabad – Kanyakumari
note: India's longest corridor. Plan fuel and food stops around major towns; rural gaps are long.

name: NH19
label: Delhi – Kanpur – Kolkata
note: Long rural gaps between Kanpur and Kolkata. 24x7 fuel food courts are the safest default.

name: NH16
label: Kolkata – Bhubaneswar – Chennai (east coast)
note: Coastal stretches with fewer lit stops at night. Plan the last stop before dark.

name: Delhi–Mumbai Expressway
label: Delhi – Jaipur – Vadodara – Mumbai
note: Planned with roughly one wayside amenity every 30-45 minutes of driving.

name: Yamuna Expressway
label: Greater Noida – Agra
note: Short corridor with a small number of fuel-and-food plazas; plan your single stop before joining.
